answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because ferrous only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, ocean is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any echo approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
